2.0.0.message: Adversarial hardening: O(1) joins (was quadratic), no resurrection of ended giveaways by queued writes, frozen entries after end, bonus-role exploit fix, retrying writes, cooldown, info button, bot/host exclusion, input caps
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Downtime and crash recovery: overdue draws on restart, resumable announcements, message repair, reaction re-sync, outage-aware retries, clock watchdog, DB connect retry
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Fork: no maximum duration (single re-arming scheduler instead of one setTimeout per giveaway)
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Fix winners only being drawn from cached members; candidates are now fetched as needed
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Fix lost entries and double announcements with a per-giveaway lock
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Fix giveaways never ending when their message was deleted
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Store times as BIGINT and entries as LONGTEXT (MySQL) so Postgres/MySQL no longer overflow
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Cryptographically secure, unbiased winner draw; weighted draw for bonus entries
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Guild scoping for management functions; prize can no longer ping @everyone
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Added pause/resume, extend/shorten, cancel, bonus entries, entry caps, account/member age requirements, any-of required roles, display options, live entry count, winner DMs, configurable texts, cleanup of old giveaways
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.0.0.message: Added giveawayCancel, giveawayPause and giveawayResume events and $giveawayDenyReason
2.0.0.author: Demonic1594

2.1.0.message: Security: management functions refuse to act from direct messages unless the guild argument is given
2.1.0.author: Demonic1594

2.1.0.message: Added $rerollGiveawayWinner, $clearGiveawayRequirements, $clearBonusEntries; every embed text is translatable through messages
2.1.0.author: Demonic1594

2.1.0.message: Fixed: lost end timer after a failed pause, retry storm while the database is down, no winners after a network error, entries lost after failed writes, requirements leaking into started giveaways, crash on a misconfigured giveawayStart event
2.1.0.author: Demonic1594

2.1.0.message: Sharding support, tested on PostgreSQL 16, CI workflow
2.1.0.author: Demonic1594

2.2.0.message: Security: $startGiveaway refuses channels of other servers; $wipeGiveaways without a guild wipes only the current server
2.2.0.author: Demonic1594

2.2.0.message: Security: entryCooldown also throttles reaction joins; clicks on deleted giveaways no longer flood the log

2.2.0.message: Fixed: role arguments refuse user and channel mentions; embed images must be http(s); long translated texts and invalid colors no longer break giveaway messages
